AMD Vivado: source the script of Open Logic once. It reads the scoped constraints of olo_base_cc_reset, olo_base_cc_bits, olo_base_cc_simple, olo_base_reset_gen and olo_base_ram_sdp wherever the system uses them, also inside the cores. tools/vivado/all_constraints_amd.tcl would also read those of olo_intf_sync, which expect device pins at its input and stop the build (ERROR 18-513) where a block synchronises internal signals with it, as ofb_pa_gty does; a block that synchronises device pins declares its own false path for them.

compile.note: Clone with the submodule 3rdParty/en_cl_fix (git clone --recursive); compile_order.txt lists its files. 4.7.0-ft.6 adds olo_base_chunker and olo_axi_lite_decoder to 4.7.0-ft.2 (ft.3), fixes the error reporting of olo_axi_master_simple and the write word count of olo_axi_master_full (ft.4), the address of transfers that olo_axi_master_simple splits at AxiMaxBeats_g (ft.5), and the transfers of olo_axi_master_full with 8-bit data and narrow addresses (ft.6). 4.7.0-ft.8 adds the response code of a failed command to the AXI masters (outputs Wr_ErrorResp and Rd_ErrorResp), olo_intf_can and the Reed-Solomon codec (olo_base_rs_encode, olo_base_rs_decode), and fixes the beat counters of olo_axi_master_simple and the write word count of the largest commands of olo_axi_master_full (ft.7); it adds FIXED bursts to the AXI masters (inputs CmdWr_Fixed and CmdRd_Fixed, default '0'), olo_base_stream_join and olo_base_stream_split, drives Out_Be of olo_base_wconv_n2m with equal widths, and checks the byte enables of olo_base_wconv_n2m and the commands of olo_intf_i2c_master at the clock edge (ft.8). The cores of the catalog are verified with 4.7.0-ft.6; the ports added since have a default (inputs) or may stay open (outputs), so they compile with 4.7.0-ft.8 unchanged.
